tasks.short: Arrange payment of freight, insurance and other charges

steps.what: Collect charge documents and first capture missing shipment or payment details
Match charges with booked freight terms and existing payment status
Resolve disputed amounts, beneficiary details or missing charge support
Prepare the payment request using verified charge and shipment details
Check the final payment request, supporting documents and finance destination
Send the approved payment request to finance for freight fee payment

tasks.design: For the payment-arrangement branch, configure charge matching and a payment-request template across {OPS_SYSTEM} and {ERP}. Keep first capture, disputes and final amount, currency, beneficiary and destination checks; submit the exact checked request to finance as a separate action, without releasing bank funds.
tasks.previous_blocker: Charge details, booking terms and payment status are checked across transport and finance records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native matching rules and request templates can remove repeated comparisons and copying.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed charges, changed beneficiaries and missing support require verification with people.
tasks.human_edge: The forwarder recognises commercially unjustified charges and resolves them before asking for payment.
tasks.altitude: Less comparison and request assembly; payment authority stays with the authorised finance process.

reach.task: Validate freight charges before arranging settlement
reach.learn: Charge terms, duplicate status and clear payment exceptions

evidence.claim: Native transport and finance matching can compare identifiers, amounts and existing payment status; this is model knowledge, not a measured freight-payment case.

assumptions: Boundary is arranging payment through finance, explicitly allowed by the task. Finance approval and bank execution remain outside this focal-role baseline and earn no saving here.

Carrier or insurer supplies the actual invoice and beneficiary details; existing booking records supply shipment identifier, agreed rate, currency and charge code. The forwarder first captures absent fields in s1 and verifies disputed or changed details in s3 and s5. No clean invoice feed is assumed.

Test native matching and request templates first. Of twenty-five comparison hours, fifteen are fixed matching and ten remain for exceptions. Of fifteen request-preparation hours, nine are copied identifiers and amounts, six remain for special instructions and checking.

The one-hour s6 is actual routing to finance, not saving an internal request. Ordinary author saves are fully retained in preparation. Final request, attachments and destination exist before s5; changes invalidate approval.
unknowns: Which charge types match existing booking lines
Whether finance already receives requests directly
research_questions: Can native matching distinguish a legitimate surcharge from a duplicate without accepting it automatically?

already_counted.description: Review comparison exceptions, complete special request instructions and check final payment meaning

incremental.description: Maintain charge mappings, duplicate rules and failed request routing

approvals.approved_version: Exact payment request, attachments and finance destination checked in s5; any change requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: fifteen comparison hours, nine copied-request hours and one actual-send hour removed, less two upkeep hours, gives 23. Cautious case: unusual currencies and accessorial charges leave twenty of twenty-five comparison hours; only five comparison hours plus nine request-copy hours and one send hour are removed, less two upkeep, giving 13. First capture, disputes and final checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor and record goods in transit

steps.what: Look up carrier events and reported locations for goods in transit
Match transit events to shipments and compare event timestamps
Ask carriers about missing transit events
First enter and verify the carrier's newly confirmed event facts
Copy verified transit locations and event times into shipment records
Interpret transit status and investigate stale or contradictory location information
outputs: understood transit status and unresolved issues

tasks.design: Configure carrier event feeds and exact shipment-reference matching in {OPS_SYSTEM}, using {PARTNER_PORTAL} data where available. Keep manual collection and identifier repair for unsupported events, first capture missing carrier answers, and interpret stale or conflicting locations personally; no customer message is invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: Carrier portals and mail use different references, event names and timestamps.
tasks.enabler_now: Native transport connectors and event mappings can replace repeated lookups and second entry.
tasks.still_hard: A missing or delayed event does not establish where cargo actually is.
tasks.human_edge: The forwarder challenges incomplete carrier information and distinguishes a late update from a real disruption.

ambition.what: Review conflicting event sequences at each received milestone rather than waiting for a manual portal round

tasks.altitude: More time interpreting exceptions and less time copying locations; no new transport decision authority.

reach.task: Track cargo movement and investigate status gaps
reach.learn: Event timestamps, shipment identifiers and carrier escalation

evidence.claim: Portbase exposes import status and port-message services; this supports a status integration capability, not complete inland location coverage.
Exact reference and timestamp matching can be configured without a model; this is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is transit milestones and locations, distinct from origin dispatch or destination receipt records in 17690. It does not include sending customer updates.

Carriers already produce shipment reference, event code, location, event time, time zone and source update time. Connectors accept only supported fields. Unsupported portals and missing identifiers are manually collected or matched within retained s1 and s2 time.

Test native connectors first. Twenty-one of thirty lookup hours and fifteen of twenty matching hours are removed; nine lookup and five matching hours remain. The ten-hour missing-event conversation in s3 is followed by five fully retained first-entry hours in s6. These are distinct from the second-entry action in s4.

S4 is second entry of already obtained carrier portal or event-feed fields into the transport record, not an author's ordinary save. Newly confirmed facts entered directly into that record in s6 bypass s4; their entry earns no second-copy saving. Conflicting or unidentified external events are held for manual resolution before copying; interpretation remains in s5. No model predicts a location.
Carrier event creation is existing supplier work, receives no saving here and is not replaced with a new reporting duty.
unknowns: Carrier feed coverage and timestamp quality
research_questions: Which actual event fields can be imported without concealing stale timestamps or mismatched shipments?

already_counted.description: Manual unsupported lookup, event matching and status interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain event mappings and investigate connector failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: twenty-one lookup, fifteen matching and twenty second-entry hours removed, less four upkeep hours, gives 52. Cautious case: unsupported carrier interfaces retain all thirty lookup and twenty matching hours; manually matched event fields still populate the internal record without twenty hours of second entry. Keeping the full four-hour upkeep allowance gives 16. Missing-event capture and interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual dispatch or receipt documents and identify the shipment
First capture quantities, dates and discrepancies absent from existing records
Copy existing shipment fields into the dispatch or receipt record
Check record identifiers, required quantities and duplicate dispatch or receipt references
Resolve substantive dispatch or receipt discrepancies against source documents
Save the author's dispatch or receipt record

tasks.design: Configure linked dispatch and receipt forms in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse existing shipment fields and validate fixed completeness and duplicate rules. Keep document reading, first capture of new quantities and discrepancies, substantive resolution and the ordinary author save fully visible.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing shipment data is recopied while new evidence is mixed with repeated fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked records and fixed validation rules can separate first capture from repeated data entry.
tasks.still_hard: Source documents can disagree about quantity, damage or when goods were actually received.
tasks.human_edge: The forwarder reconciles substantive discrepancies rather than assuming an internally consistent record is true.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record entry and mechanical checking; responsibility for source accuracy is unchanged.

reach.task: Maintain accurate shipping and receiving records
reach.learn: Source reconciliation and distinguishing new facts from reused master data

evidence.claim: Boltrics offers warehouse, transport and forwarding records in one software family; this supports record configuration, not a measured saving for this task.

assumptions: Boundary is actual dispatch and receipt record maintenance, not transit location monitoring in 17692 or a new trailing report.

The warehouse, carrier or receiving party supplies actual document reference, date, quantity and discrepancy evidence. The forwarder reads it in s1 and first enters absent facts in s2. Existing shipment master supplies shipment identifier, parties, goods description and booked unit fields; no free extraction is assumed.

Test native linked forms first. Twenty-eight of thirty-five repeat-copy hours are removed; seven remain for unmatched or incomplete records. Nine of fifteen fixed-check hours are removed; six exception-check hours remain. Source reading and substantive reconciliation remain fully retained.

The ordinary same-system save is one hour, ungated and fully retained. No booking, receipt acceptance or external dispatch is performed by this internal record save. Existing automatic record runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Which master fields still need repeated entry
Existing native completeness and duplicate controls
research_questions: Can linked forms reuse fields while preserving the actual source quantity and discrepancy evidence?

already_counted.description: Repair unmatched copied fields, inspect validation exceptions and resolve substantive discrepancies

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and investigate validation errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: twenty-eight repeat-entry and nine fixed-check hours removed, less three upkeep hours, gives 34. Cautious case: legacy shipment masters lack compatible unit and party fields, retaining all thirty-five copy hours; fixed identifier and duplicate checks still remove nine hours, less three upkeep, giving 6. All first capture and author-save time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the shipment requirements and available service dates
Clarify missing cargo or transport constraints with the customer or carrier
First enter and verify the clarified cargo and transport constraints
Look up carrier space, departures and booking conditions
Negotiate capacity exceptions and choose the suitable carrier offer
Copy verified shipment fields into the carrier reservation request
Check final reservation details, carrier, price and cancellation conditions
outputs: checked reservation version and carrier destination

steps.what: Send the approved request to reserve space with the selected carrier
inputs: checked reservation version and carrier destination

tasks.design: Configure native carrier availability and reservation connections between {OPS_SYSTEM} and {PARTNER_PORTAL}. Keep requirement clarification and carrier negotiation, populate only verified booking fields, and submit the exact final reservation only after the forwarder checks its terms and destination.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability lookup and booking fields are repeated across carrier portals, while exceptions still need negotiation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native carrier connectors can retrieve supported offers and reuse the shipment record for a reservation request.
tasks.still_hard: Space, special cargo acceptance, cancellation terms and deadlines can change during negotiation.
tasks.human_edge: The forwarder judges whether a carrier offer really fits the shipment and its commercial risk.
tasks.altitude: Less lookup and second entry; carrier selection and commitment authority remain with the forwarder.

reach.task: Book suitable cargo capacity with carriers
reach.learn: Capacity constraints and exact reservation terms

evidence.claim: Native carrier connections can reuse verified booking data and retrieve supported availability; this is model knowledge, not a claim that all carriers provide compatible booking interfaces.

assumptions: Boundary is selecting and submitting an actual carrier reservation, not rewriting the customer order or producing a separate booking report.

The customer order supplies shipment identifier, origin, destination, dates, cargo, weight, dimensions and special conditions. The forwarder resolves gaps during ten conversation hours in s2 and first enters the resulting facts during five fully retained hours in s8. Carriers produce offer identifier, available capacity, validity and terms; unsupported offers remain manual within s3.

Test native carrier connections first. Six of fifteen availability-lookup hours are removed; nine remain for unsupported services and term interpretation. S5 removes fifteen hours of re-keying already verified fields into a second system, not first capture or a same-system save.

Manual request repair for unmapped fields is included in retained s6 time and the upkeep allowance. The final payload and carrier destination exist before s6; changed terms, cargo or destination require fresh approval before the separate actual send.
Existing carrier processing and returned confirmation runtime are not human savings. Any later negotiation after rejection remains with people.
unknowns: Which reservation terms need manual review
research_questions: Can native booking connectors preserve exact cargo details and the accepted cancellation terms?

already_counted.description: Review unsupported availability and check the final reservation meaning and conditions

incremental.description: Maintain carrier field mappings and resolve failed or rejected submissions

approvals.approved_version: Exact reservation payload, selected carrier endpoint, offer and terms checked in s6; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: six lookup, fifteen second-entry and one actual-submit hour removed, less two upkeep hours, gives 20. Cautious case: bespoke cargo fields require all fifteen request-entry hours despite an available carrier submit interface; the supported availability view still removes six lookup hours and the real submit removes one, less two upkeep, giving 5. Negotiation, first capture and final checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated matching, transport-event copying and carrier data entry. Charge disputes, shipment exceptions and financial or transport commitments remain human decisions.
reach: Cargo and freight agent: improve event reconciliation and capacity booking
Brokerage clerk: learn source and identifier checks without assuming customs authority
skills_to_grow: Carrier event provenance and timestamp interpretation
role.ambitious_version: A forwarder who handles fewer repeated entries and catches more genuine shipment exceptions before committing money or capacity.
